subject: Lightweight intake for sandbox demo — traffic matrix & 3 slots
messages:
From: Alex Morales <alex@rapidcart.io>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Quick sandbox demo?

Hi Naomi,

I signed up for the sandbox yesterday and saw Redwood's demo flow. Would love a quick walkthrough this week to validate integration approach. High level: RapidCart is building a checkout personalization layer (recommendations + checkout copy) and we want to test embeddings + generation latency for cart sizes ~50-200 SKUs.

What does your SDR process look like? Can you share 3 slots and any pre-demo info you need?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Morales
Head of Product, RapidCart
alex@rapidcart.io

--
Attachment: none

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Alex Morales <alex@rapidcart.io>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sandbox demo? — a couple quick questions before we book

Hey Alex — welcome and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a focused 30m walkthrough. Before I lock times, a few quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session and bring the right folks: 

1) Primary demo focus: embeddings (search/retrieval), generation for checkout copy, or both? If both, which should be prioritized?
2) Peak concurrency expectation for inference calls during the pilot (rps or concurrent requests)? e.g., bursty traffic around promos vs steady throughput.
3) Typical request shape: average prompt length & expected generated tokens per request.
4) Expected monthly inference volume (tokens / requests) for the sandbox period (first 4–8 weeks).
5) Timeline: are you aiming to evaluate this week, next 30 days, or Q4? Any hard deadlines?
6) Compliance/SSO needs for the demo (SSO, IP allowlist, VPC access)?

If it's easier, I can propose three 30m windows (Pacific TZ) and we can pick one. Proposed slots:
- Tue 10/06 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 10/07 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 10/08 09:00–09:30 PT

I attached a short pre-demo checklist (redwood-pre-demo-checklist.pdf) and a traffic-matrix template (traffic-matrix.csv) — if you can drop the matrix back with estimates for prompt sizes and concurrent requests that’ll help us configure an appropriate demo (and whether to spin a dedicated dev pool).

Cheers,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

--
Attachment: redwood-pre-demo-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Alex Morales <alex@rapidcart.io>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Kline <jk@rapidcart.io>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sandbox demo? — answers + draft matrix attached

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick reply. Answers inline below and I attached the traffic-matrix.csv filled with our rough numbers.

1) Both — primary is embeddings for product search and similarity, secondary is short-form generation (1–2 sentences) to A/B checkout copy. Prioritize embeddings.
2) Peak concurrency: ~30 concurrent inference requests during peak; steady-state ~5–8 rps. Bursty during flash sales (short spikes to ~80 concurrent).
3) Request shape: average prompt ~120 tokens; generation target ~40 tokens.
4) Sandbox volume: we expect ~150k inference calls / month initially (~6M tokens/month), may ramp quickly if results look good.
5) Timeline: aiming to validate in the next 2 weeks and run a short pilot in Q4. Not a firm hard deadline but tight.
6) No SSO or VPC for the initial sandbox; may need SSO for pilot.

Preferred slot: Wed 10/07 14:00–14:30 PT works for Jordan and me.

Thanks — matrix attached as traffic-matrix.csv.

—Alex

Attachments: traffic-matrix.csv (stub)

Date: 2026-10-06T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sandbox demo? — confirmed Wed 10/07 14:00 PT

Perfect — slot confirmed! I’ve booked Wed 10/07 14:00–14:30 PT on my calendar and shared a Cal link — https://cal.com/naomi/redwood-30m. Joining on the call from our side: me (SDR) + Priyom (solutions engineer) who can speak to throughput and dev onboarding. Ben will join if we need to talk quick pricing/commitments.

Pre-demo notes:
- We reviewed the matrix — thanks, that’s helpful. Given your expected burst profile, we’ll bring a couple of options: small shared dev pool with KV/prefix caching vs a short-lived dedicated dev pool to emulate bursts.
- If you can drop any sample prompts or example product catalogs (anonymized) ahead of time, that’ll speed up the demo prep.
- No security gating required for the sandbox session.

See you Wed — calendar invite and meeting link are attached.

Best,
Naomi

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics
